485:t_1:3.en:
$$タケル$$
「$n showed me that the truth lies beyond opposites like hope and despair.」

485:t_1:4.en:
$$マーグ$$
「Envy, hatred, grief, and resentment are all human emotions.」

485:t_1:5.en:
$$タケル$$
「Light and darkness are two sides of the same coin... We need both to be human.」

485:t_1:6.en:
$$マーグ$$
「That's right. And we are their symbols.」

485:t_1:7.en:
$$タケル$$
「Now I understand what you meant, Brother.」

485:t_1:8.en:
$$マーグ$$
「You and I are twins... We were originally a single person.」

485:t_1:9.en:
$$マーグ$$
「When we split into two souls, each of us took on the destiny of light or darkness.」

485:t_1:10.en:
$$マーグ$$
「That must be why $$ズール$$, who lives only in darkness, took an interest in me.」

485:t_1:11.en:
$$タケル$$
「And $$ズール$$ wanted me, with the factor of light, and you, with the factor of darkness, to destroy each other.」

485:t_1:12.en:
$$マーグ$$
「But now we know each other's destinies, and we are about to unite our power.」

485:t_1:13.en:
$$タケル$$
「By accepting you... By accepting darkness.」

485:t_1:14.en:
$$マーグ$$
「Darkness does not mean evil. Being trapped in darkness alone is what creates evil.」

485:t_1:15.en:
$$タケル$$
「Then what does it mean to live only in light?」

485:t_1:16.en:
$$マーグ$$
「...Perhaps that does not necessarily create justice...」

485:t_1:18.en:
$$マーグ$$
「$$マーズ$$... You must find that answer through your own efforts.」

485:t_1:19.en:
$$タケル$$
「No, Brother. You'll do it with me.」

485:t_1:20.en:
$$マーグ$$
「You're right. I will live within you forever.」

485:t_1:21.en:
$$タケル$$
「Brother... From now on, we'll always be together...」

486:t_000:1.en:
$$渓$$
「The other dimension where we fought $$ハーデス$$ during the $$時獄戦役$$...?!」

486:t_000:2.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「The underworld... Or perhaps I should call it the world of death.」

486:t_002:0.en:
$$タケル$$
「$$ゲシュタルト$$ isn't here...!」

486:t_002:1.en:
$$正太郎$$
「But he said something about $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ being here.」

486:t_004:0.en:
$$ズール$$
「It has been a long time, $$マーズ$$. And you Earthlings.」

486:t_004:2.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「You villains just won't stay down! We already beat you to a pulp!」

486:t_004:4.en:
$$ズール$$
「Having gained the power of darkness, we are eternal beings.」

486:t_004:6.en:
$$勝平$$
「So no matter how many times we beat you, you'll keep coming back?!」

486:t_004:8.en:
$$ズール$$
「That is the mark of a higher-dimensional life-form... Of one who has obtained the power of a god.」

486:t_004:9.en:
$$正太郎$$
「But we beat $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ once with $$鉄人$$'s power of the sun! Then we can do it again...」

486:t_004:10.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「I will not allow it!」

486:t_005:3.en:
$$厚井$$
「Impossible! The commands from the $$Ｖコン$$ to $$鉄人$$ use Rainbow Wave, which is immune to all jamming signals!」

486:t_005:4.en:
$$ズール$$
「Such things are meaningless before the will of darkness.」

486:t_005:5.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Now, come to me! $$鉄人２８号#robot$$!」

486:t_006:0.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「So I can do no more than wrest control away from him.」

486:t_006:1.en:
$$ズール$$
「No matter. We have neutralized one obstacle.」

486:t_006:4.en:
$$正太郎$$
「It's no use! It won't accept my commands!」

486:t_006:5.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「But it looks like $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ can't completely control $$鉄人$$, either!」

486:t_006:6.en:
$$シモン$$
「Then we'll take it back by force!」

486:t_006:7.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Can you really do that?」

486:t_006:8.en:
$$万丈$$
「We will. Even if this is your home turf.」

486:t_006:9.en:
$$ズール$$
「You do not understand the horror of this dimension.」

486:t_006:10.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「This is a world of darkness... Where the souls of the dead gather.」

486:t_006:12.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Among them are spirits of the dead who have fallen outside the cycle of reincarnation.」

486:t_006:13.en:
$$ズール$$
「Yes... That allows us to do this.」

486:t_007:2.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「They, too, failed to vanish entirely and have remained in the world of death.」

486:t_007:4.en:
$$ズール$$
「$$マーズ$$. You and your allies will suffer endlessly in this world of darkness.」

486:t_007:6.en:
$$ズール$$
「Envy, resentment, hatred, grief... Humanity's negative emotions...」

486:t_007:7.en:
$$ズール$$
「The greatest of them is the fear of death... Darkness itself will crush your hearts.」

486:t_007:8.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「There is no light here.」

486:t_007:9.en:
$$ズール$$
「You will never reach the sun's radiance. You will become one with darkness here.」

486:t_008:0.en:
$$竜馬$$
「After all that big talk, you're running away?!」

486:t_008:1.en:
$$赤木$$
「I hate to admit it, but that's a relief this time...!」

486:t_008:2.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Revived Angels and the army of darkness...」

486:t_008:3.en:
$$シリウス$$
「From the way they spoke, these may not be our only enemies.」

486:t_008:4.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「And this place... It's so cold and dark... I can barely breathe...」

486:t_008:5.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「So this is... the world of darkness...」
